text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I am here to help you with your acute diarrhea. To begin, how long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and have you noticed any blood or mucus in your stool?

speaker: Patient
text: 58-year-old female. The patient has been treated for community-acquired pneumonia with levofloxacin on the medical floor. She reports developing watery diarrhea with at least 9 episodes within the last two days, accompanied by lower abdominal discomfort and cramping.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Antibiotic-associated diarrhea (likely *Clostridioides difficile* infection). Given your recent treatment with levofloxacin for pneumonia, along with frequent watery diarrhea and cramping, this is highly suggestive of a *C. diff* infection. I would like to confirm this with specific testing: REQUEST TEST: C_diff_toxin_stool_assay. Additionally, please tell me if you have had a fever or noticed any abdominal tenderness.
